notes: All 12 views inspected. Rapier with a long slender tapering blade and an elaborate swept brass hilt: a knuckle bow, two curved side rings, straight quillons with ball finials, a ribbed grip and an ovoid pommel. The swept guard is genuine open tube geometry, not a flat cut-out, which the top and left views confirm. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: The guard rings are thin tubes; they will alias at small on-screen sizes.
